# ElvisOperatorCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `ElvisOperatorCanBeUsedInspection`

A full ternary whose "then" branch repeats its condition (`$a ? $a : $b`) can
be written with the short ternary operator `$a ?: $b` (PHP 5.3+), which is
shorter and evaluates the condition once.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,4,5} [Before]
<?php
$label  = $name ? $name : 'guest';
$limit  = $cfg['max'] ? ( $cfg['max'] ) : 10;
$owner  = (($user)) ? $user : $fallback;
$title  = $page->title ? $page->title : (DEFAULT_TITLE);

$keep1  = $name ?: 'guest';
$keep2  = $name ? 'guest' : $name;
$keep3  = !$name ? $name : 'guest';
$keep4  = isset($name) ? $name : 'guest';
$keep5  = getTitle() ? getTitle() : DEFAULT_TITLE;
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
$label  = $name ?: 'guest';
$limit  = $cfg['max'] ?: 10;
$owner  = (($user)) ?: $fallback;
$title  = $page->title ?: (DEFAULT_TITLE);

$keep1  = $name ?: 'guest';
$keep2  = $name ? 'guest' : $name;
$keep3  = !$name ? $name : 'guest';
$keep4  = isset($name) ? $name : 'guest';
$keep5  = getTitle() ? getTitle() : DEFAULT_TITLE;
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Use the short ternary: &#39;$name ?: &#39;guest&#39;&#39;.</li>
<li>line 3: Use the short ternary: &#39;$cfg[&#39;max&#39;] ?: 10&#39;.</li>
<li>line 4: Use the short ternary: &#39;(($user)) ?: $fallback&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: Use the short ternary: &#39;$page-&gt;title ?: (DEFAULT_TITLE)&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ElvisOperatorCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ElvisOperatorCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection ElvisOperatorCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
